notes: This is the Strategy Department's briefing on China's 2026 Government Work Report and the Outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030). The first half covers the documents: what 2025 delivered, the targets and tasks set for 2026, and the direction set for the next five years. The second half covers delivery so far this year. Published data run to August, and third-quarter GDP is not due until October 19, so growth figures stop at the first half. We close with what this means for us and three things to do in the fourth quarter. Every figure comes from official documents or releases by the National Bureau of Statistics, the Ministry of Finance and other agencies, and each data page names its source.
